reason: Implements 24 GTM tools and nine credential auxiliaries; one deprecated stub and create-tag trigger field mismatch require review.
exposure: All 33 tools registered unconditionally; startup requires MCP_GTM_MASTER_KEY configuration. Separate sibling product servers excluded. Hosted aggregate gateway has an allowlist and modifies write descriptions/schemas; this catalog captures the standalone GTM server.
limitations: Schemas reconstructed by evaluating registration configuration only, using exact locked Zod 4.4.3 offline; no server startup, OAuth or GTM API operations were invoked.
No credentialed integration verification; handlers use custom HTTP client and If-Match fingerprint concurrency mechanism.
complete_google_oauth_flow is an exposed deprecated error-only stub.
gtm_create_tag sends plural firingTriggerIds/blockingTriggerIds body fields; GTM resource uses singular firingTriggerId/blockingTriggerId (also reflected in this repo update-tag handler).
gtm_create_version description says confirm defaults false, but actual registered schema has required boolean confirm without a default.
List handlers issue a single request and do not exhaust API nextPageToken pagination.
Hosted aggregate catalog differs from standalone GTM and is outside the selected server scope.

tools.name: list_google_oauth_apps
tools.description: Returns all Google OAuth applications registered in the local encrypted database. Each entry shows label, client_id, declared scopes, and created_at. Client secrets are never returned — stored encrypted. Use before starting an OAuth flow or to audit registered credentials.
tools.behavior: Lists OAuth applications from the local GTM encrypted database without exposing client secrets.

tools.name: register_google_oauth_app
tools.description: Registers a new Google OAuth application in the local encrypted database. client_secret is AES-256 encrypted before storage. redirect_uri must be a loopback URI (http://127.0.0.1:PORT/oauth/callback) — OOB redirect is not supported (Google deprecated it 2023-01-31). After registration, use start_google_oauth_flow to connect an account.

label.description: Short unique name for this app, e.g. 'my-gtm-app'

client_id.description: Google OAuth client_id from Google Cloud Console

tools.behavior: Stores an OAuth application in the GTM database and rejects deprecated OOB redirect URIs.

tools.name: delete_google_oauth_app
tools.description: Deletes a registered Google OAuth application by label. Blocked if accounts are linked to it — delete those first with delete_google_account. Action is irreversible.

app_label.description: Label of the OAuth app to delete

tools.behavior: Deletes a local OAuth application, with a specific error when accounts still reference it.

tools.name: list_google_accounts
tools.description: Returns all Google accounts connected via OAuth or Service Account stored in the local database. Shows label, google_email, auth_method, scopes_granted, expires_at, and is_default. Tokens are never returned — stored encrypted.
tools.behavior: Lists locally registered Google accounts in the GTM package database.

tools.name: start_google_oauth_flow
tools.description: Begins a Google OAuth authorization code flow with automatic loopback callback. Opens a local HTTP listener, returns an authorize_url to open in a browser. Waits up to 5 minutes for the user to complete authorization, then saves the account. account_label must be free (not already taken — check list_google_accounts).

app_label.description: Label of the registered OAuth app to use

account_label.description: Desired label for the new account

login_hint.description: Google email to pre-fill in consent screen (optional)

tools.behavior: Runs Google OAuth through a loopback callback and stores the resulting account credentials.

tools.name: complete_google_oauth_flow
tools.description: Deprecated. Use start_google_oauth_flow which auto-completes via loopback. OOB flow no longer supported since Google deprecated it on 2023-01-31.

app_label.description: Label of the registered OAuth app

tools.behavior: Deprecated stub always returns isError with instructions to use start_google_oauth_flow.

tools.name: delete_google_account
tools.description: Deletes a connected Google account by label. Removes tokens from the database. Does not revoke tokens on Google's side. To reconnect, run start_google_oauth_flow again.

account_label.description: Label of the account to delete

tools.behavior: Deletes a locally registered Google account by label.

tools.name: set_default_google_account
tools.description: Marks a Google account as the default. Tools that accept an optional 'account' parameter will use this account when none is specified. Use list_google_accounts to see available labels.

account_label.description: Label of the account to set as default

tools.behavior: Sets a locally registered account as the default for the GTM package.

tools.name: register_google_service_account
tools.description: Registers a Google Service Account from a JSON key file. Validates the key by obtaining an access token before saving. Required for tools that need Service Account authentication. Provide scopes as space-delimited string.

account_label.description: Label for this service account, e.g. 'gtm-sa'

json_path.description: Absolute path to the service account JSON key file

tools.behavior: Reads a service-account JSON key, verifies token acquisition and stores its encrypted credentials.

tools.name: gtm_list_accounts
tools.description: Lists all GTM accounts accessible to the resolved Google account.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

tools.behavior: Reads GTM accounts through the v2 API and caches the extracted accounts array.

tools.name: gtm_list_containers
tools.description: Lists all containers in a GTM account.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

tools.behavior: Reads GTM containers under an account and caches the extracted containers array.

tools.name: gtm_list_workspaces
tools.description: Lists all workspaces in a GTM container.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

tools.behavior: Reads GTM workspaces under a container and caches the extracted workspaces array.

tools.name: gtm_list_tags
tools.description: Lists all tags in a GTM workspace.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

tools.behavior: Reads workspace tags and caches the extracted tags array.

tools.name: gtm_list_triggers
tools.description: Lists all triggers in a GTM workspace.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

tools.behavior: Reads workspace triggers and caches the extracted triggers array.

tools.name: gtm_list_variables
tools.description: Lists all variables in a GTM workspace.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

tools.behavior: Reads workspace variables and caches the extracted variables array.

tools.name: gtm_list_versions
tools.description: Lists version headers for a GTM container. Short TTL (5 min) because the edit cycle may create new versions frequently.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

tools.behavior: Reads container version_headers and caches containerVersionHeader.

tools.name: gtm_get_version
tools.description: Fetches a specific GTM container version by version ID.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

tools.behavior: Reads a container version and caches the response data.

tools.name: gtm_list_user_permissions
tools.description: Lists all users with access to a GTM account and their account/container permissions. Not cached — permission grants change out-of-band and staleness has access-control consequences.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

tools.behavior: Reads account user_permissions without a cache.

tools.name: gtm_create_workspace
tools.description: WRITE — creates a GTM Workspace in the given Container. Requires confirm:true.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

confirm.description: Set to true to execute. False returns dry-run preview.

tools.behavior: Previews by default or POSTs a new workspace when confirmed.

tools.name: gtm_create_tag
tools.description: WRITE — creates a GTM Tag in the given Workspace. Requires confirm:true.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

firingTriggerIds.description: IDs of triggers that fire this tag.

blockingTriggerIds.description: IDs of triggers that block this tag.

confirm.description: Set to true to execute. False returns dry-run preview.

tools.behavior: Previews by default or POSTs a tag; firingTriggerIds/blockingTriggerIds are sent as plural body keys, inconsistent with GTM singular firingTriggerId/blockingTriggerId.

tools.name: gtm_create_trigger
tools.description: WRITE — creates a GTM Trigger in the given Workspace. Requires confirm:true.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

confirm.description: Set to true to execute. False returns dry-run preview.

tools.behavior: Previews by default or POSTs a trigger with supplied filters and parameters.

tools.name: gtm_create_variable
tools.description: WRITE — creates a GTM Variable in the given Workspace. Requires confirm:true.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

confirm.description: Set to true to execute. False returns dry-run preview.

tools.behavior: Previews by default or POSTs a variable with supplied parameters.

tools.name: gtm_update_tag
tools.description: WRITE — updates a GTM Tag via PUT. Requires a cached etag (run gtm_list_tags first). confirm:false returns dry-run preview; confirm:true executes the update.

account.description: Registered Google account label (optional).

tools.behavior: Previews or GETs the current tag and PUTs merged fields with a cached fingerprint sent through If-Match.

tools.name: gtm_delete_tag
tools.description: WRITE — deletes a GTM Tag. Requires a cached etag (run gtm_list_tags first). confirm:false returns a dry-run preview; confirm:true executes the delete.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

confirm.description: Set to true to execute the delete. false returns a dry-run preview.

tools.behavior: Previews or GETs the tag and DELETEs it with a cached fingerprint sent through If-Match.

tools.name: gtm_create_version
tools.description: Creates a checkpoint from current workspace state. Does NOT publish — workspace remains active. Use gtm_publish_version separately to make this version live. With confirm:false (default) returns a dry-run preview. With confirm:true executes the create_version call.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

name.description: Version name (human-readable label for the checkpoint).

notes.description: Optional notes describing what changed in this version.

confirm.description: Set to true to execute. False (default) returns dry-run preview.

tools.behavior: Previews or POSTs workspace:create_version; registered confirm is required despite description saying default false.

tools.name: gtm_create_container
tools.description: WRITE — creates a GTM Container in the given Account. Requires confirm:true.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

domainName.description: Domain names associated with the container (optional).

confirm.description: Set to true to execute. False returns dry-run preview.

tools.behavior: Previews or POSTs a container with usageContext and optional domains/notes.

tools.name: gtm_update_account
tools.description: WRITE — updates a GTM Account (name, shareData). Fetches the current account first to obtain a fresh fingerprint/etag and the full resource, then PUTs the merged resource. confirm:false returns dry-run preview with NO network call; confirm:true executes the read + update.

account.description: Registered Google account label (optional).

shareData.description: Whether data may be shared anonymously with Google.

tools.behavior: Previews without network calls or GETs the current account and PUTs merged name/shareData.

tools.name: gtm_create_user_permission
tools.description: WRITE — grants a user Account and/or Container access on a GTM account. Requires confirm:true.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

emailAddress.description: Email address of the user to grant access to.

confirm.description: Set to true to execute. False returns dry-run preview.

tools.behavior: Previews or POSTs user_permissions, mapping accountPermission to accountAccess.permission.

tools.name: gtm_update_user_permission
tools.description: WRITE — updates a user's Account/Container access on a GTM account via PUT. Requires permissionId (from gtm_list_user_permissions). confirm:false returns dry-run preview; confirm:true executes the update.

account.description: Registered Google account label (optional).

emailAddress.description: Email address of the user (usually unchanged).

containerAccess.description: Per-container permissions (replaces the existing set when provided).

tools.behavior: Previews or PUTs supplied account/container access to a user permission.

tools.name: gtm_publish_version
tools.description: DANGER — affects live container. Publishes a specific GTM container version, making it live. Verify version_id is the intended checkpoint. Two-step gate: confirm:true + acknowledge_live:'I-UNDERSTAND-THIS-IS-LIVE:<version_id>'. With confirm:false (default) returns a dry-run preview with the target version and a warning.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

versionId.description: Target GTM Container Version ID to make live.

confirm.description: Set to true to execute publish. False (default) returns dry-run preview.

acknowledge_live.description: Required when confirm:true. Must be: I-UNDERSTAND-THIS-IS-LIVE:<versionId>

tools.behavior: Previews or POSTs versions/<versionId>:publish after confirmation and live acknowledgement.

tools.name: gtm_rollback
tools.description: DANGER — affects live container. Two-step DB-backed rollback. Step 1 (confirm:false): previews rollback from live → target version, stores a plan (5 min TTL), returns plan_id. Step 2 (confirm:true + plan_id + acknowledge_live): atomically claims plan, re-checks fingerprint, publishes target version. acknowledge_live format: I-UNDERSTAND-THIS-IS-LIVE:<containerId>.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional).

to_version_id.description: Target version to roll back to.

plan_id.description: Required for confirm step. UUID from step 1.

tools.behavior: Stores a five-minute rollback plan, atomically claims it, checks live fingerprint and publishes the target version after confirmation.

tools.name: gtm_delete_container
tools.description: DANGER — irreversibly deletes a GTM Container and everything inside it (tags, triggers, variables, workspaces, versions). Verify containerId with gtm_list_containers first. Two-step gate: confirm:true + acknowledge_live:'I-UNDERSTAND-THIS-IS-LIVE:<containerId>'. With confirm:false (default) returns a dry-run preview with a warning.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

containerId.description: GTM Container ID to delete (numeric string).

confirm.description: Set to true to execute the delete. False (default) returns dry-run preview.

acknowledge_live.description: Required when confirm:true. Must be: I-UNDERSTAND-THIS-IS-LIVE:<containerId>

tools.behavior: Previews or DELETEs the container after confirmation and matching live acknowledgement.

tools.name: gtm_delete_user_permission
tools.description: DANGER — revokes a user's access to a GTM account and all of its containers. Verify permissionId with gtm_list_user_permissions first. Two-step gate: confirm:true + acknowledge_live:'I-UNDERSTAND-THIS-IS-LIVE:<permissionId>'. With confirm:false (default) returns a dry-run preview with a warning.

account.description: Label of a registered Google account (optional; uses default if omitted).

confirm.description: Set to true to execute the delete. False (default) returns dry-run preview.

acknowledge_live.description: Required when confirm:true. Must be: I-UNDERSTAND-THIS-IS-LIVE:<permissionId>

tools.behavior: Previews or DELETEs a user permission after confirmation and matching live acknowledgement.

review.summary: Browse tracking resources, create workspace drafts, and preview confirmed trigger and variable edits.
